title: Two Sum in Sorted Array
statement:
Given a sorted array of integers and a target T, use the two-pointer technique to find two numbers that add up to T.

Return their 1-based indices as a space-separated pair in ascending order. It is guaranteed that exactly one solution exists.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and T.
The second line contains N space-separated integers in sorted order.

starterCode.python:
line = input().split()
n, t = int(line[0]), int(line[1])
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
